snippet.title: I Am Future -  OUT NOW on Console | PlayStation, XBOX & Nintendo Switch!💙
snippet.description:
Buy now for PS, Xbox, and Switch:
🔵 https://store.playstation.com/concept/10014424
🟢 https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9n8h6cz6bn6b
🔴 https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/i-am-future-cozy-apocalypse-survival-switch/

Free trials available on PS and Xbox!

I Am Future is a relaxing survival game where you build a cozy base on a skyscraper roof in the middle of a flooded post-apocalyptic city.

*  *  *
 
🏙️🌊 The whole world has been struck by tsunamis, and you're stuck on a skyscraper roof? No worries, future-dweller - with I Am Future, you're in for the best time of your life! Develop an organic farm, dismantle old-world appliances for crafting resources, construct a high-tech base to cover your basic needs, and explore a gorgeous flooded city while cute robots do chores for you 🤖. As you settle down for a new peaceful life in the civilization's ruins, uncover the mystery behind the great catastrophe.

*  *  *

👥 Join the I Am Future community:
🌐 Discord: https://discord.gg/iamfuturegame
🌐 Twitter (X): https://twitter.com/iamfuturegame
🌐 Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/IAmFutureGame
🌐 Steam forums: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1658040/discussions/
